notes: Source: ColecoVision Owner's Manual (1982, Coleco; archive.org Colecovision_Owners_Manual_1982_Coleco), section «HAND CONTROLLERS» (KEYPAD, CONTROL STICK, SIDE BUTTONS, OVERLAY KEYPAD slot). Quotes are verbatim lines of archive.org's OCR text (the item's _djvu.txt) of the maker's scanned manual, OCR errors and spacing included; the scan, not the OCR, is the authority, and a human should re-read each line against the page image. The OCR is poor («KEYPAO», «1hern», «Attach me»); the scan reads «KEYPAD», «them», «Attach the». Mapping: the eight-directional control stick = stick 1; keypad and side buttons are listed but the manual does not state their counts (it names keypad buttons 1–8, * and #, which is not a full count), so both counts are null. The three kinds are the section's complete list. wired=true: the controllers plug into jacks inside the console's storage compartments. The Computer History Museum records 102766388 and 102633114 («Coleco … game controller», Taiwan) do not say which console they belong to and are not used. Body dimensions, mass, cable length: null.
